s5-end-perfect.001.text: The last sigil on the Precentor’s heart turns, and the clock-face of eight Hours is complete.
s5-end-perfect.001.speaker: Narrator
s5-end-perfect.001.context: The Perfect End: failure scene when the finale (op5-9) is lost, before the retry prompt "s5-end-perfect" (Kessendorf — Hollow Night, after Compline), line 1 of 18.

s5-end-perfect.002.text: He does not die. He only stops. And the silence goes out of him like a tide.
s5-end-perfect.002.speaker: Narrator
s5-end-perfect.002.context: The Perfect End: failure scene when the finale (op5-9) is lost, before the retry prompt "s5-end-perfect" (Kessendorf — Hollow Night, after Compline), line 2 of 18.

s5-end-perfect.003.text: Now let your servant depart in peace.
s5-end-perfect.003.speaker: The Precentor
s5-end-perfect.003.context: The Perfect End: failure scene when the finale (op5-9) is lost, before the retry prompt "s5-end-perfect" (Kessendorf — Hollow Night, after Compline), line 3 of 18.

s5-end-perfect.004.text: It reaches the crypt first. Orsa sits down on the stone floor with her pick across her knees and closes her eyes.
s5-end-perfect.004.speaker: Narrator
s5-end-perfect.004.context: The Perfect End: failure scene when the finale (op5-9) is lost, before the retry prompt "s5-end-perfect" (Kessendorf — Hollow Night, after Compline), line 4 of 18.

s5-end-perfect.005.text: Then the stair. Then the street. Then the ward.
s5-end-perfect.005.speaker: Narrator
s5-end-perfect.005.context: The Perfect End: failure scene when the finale (op5-9) is lost, before the retry prompt "s5-end-perfect" (Kessendorf — Hollow Night, after Compline), line 5 of 18.

s5-end-perfect.006.text: Doctor — the patients. Their breathing. It’s slowing, all of them, together, like one—
s5-end-perfect.006.speaker: Sister Ilse
s5-end-perfect.006.context: The Perfect End: failure scene when the finale (op5-9) is lost, before the retry prompt "s5-end-perfect" (Kessendorf — Hollow Night, after Compline), line 6 of 18.

s5-end-perfect.007.text: She does not finish the word. She lies down on the ward floor beside the cots, very neatly, as if she means to rest a moment.
s5-end-perfect.007.speaker: Narrator
s5-end-perfect.007.context: The Perfect End: failure scene when the finale (op5-9) is lost, before the retry prompt "s5-end-perfect" (Kessendorf — Hollow Night, after Compline), line 7 of 18.

s5-end-perfect.008.text: The Watch on the Penny Stair lowers its pikes. Mauer counts his men once, and does not reach the end of the count.
s5-end-perfect.008.speaker: Narrator
s5-end-perfect.008.context: The Perfect End: failure scene when the finale (op5-9) is lost, before the retry prompt "s5-end-perfect" (Kessendorf — Hollow Night, after Compline), line 8 of 18.

s5-end-perfect.009.text: The drover at the Crooked Goose puts down his dice. The girl with the horn-buds sleeps, and her mother sleeps beside her.
s5-end-perfect.009.speaker: Narrator
s5-end-perfect.009.context: The Perfect End: failure scene when the finale (op5-9) is lost, before the retry prompt "s5-end-perfect" (Kessendorf — Hollow Night, after Compline), line 9 of 18.

s5-end-perfect.010.text: Every candle in Kessendorf stands perfectly still, and then, one by one, goes quietly out.
s5-end-perfect.010.speaker: Narrator
s5-end-perfect.010.context: The Perfect End: failure scene when the finale (op5-9) is lost, before the retry prompt "s5-end-perfect" (Kessendorf — Hollow Night, after Compline), line 10 of 18.

s5-end-perfect.011.text: Hush the ward, and hush the street; / sleep is kind, and death is sweet.
s5-end-perfect.011.speaker: The Choir
s5-end-perfect.011.context: The Perfect End: failure scene when the finale (op5-9) is lost, before the retry prompt "s5-end-perfect" (Kessendorf — Hollow Night, after Compline), line 11 of 18.

s5-end-perfect.012.text: Only Kreuzer is awake. The Litany keeps him, the way it kept every patient he ever held together with it.
s5-end-perfect.012.speaker: Narrator
s5-end-perfect.012.context: The Perfect End: failure scene when the finale (op5-9) is lost, before the retry prompt "s5-end-perfect" (Kessendorf — Hollow Night, after Compline), line 12 of 18.

s5-end-perfect.013.text: Aurel. Wake them. You were a surgeon once. You swore to it.
s5-end-perfect.013.speaker: Dr. Kreuzer
s5-end-perfect.013.context: The Perfect End: failure scene when the finale (op5-9) is lost, before the retry prompt "s5-end-perfect" (Kessendorf — Hollow Night, after Compline), line 13 of 18.

s5-end-perfect.014.text: I am keeping it, Doctor. No more pain. No more plague. No more surgeons. It is the perfect end.
s5-end-perfect.014.speaker: The Precentor
s5-end-perfect.014.context: The Perfect End: failure scene when the finale (op5-9) is lost, before the retry prompt "s5-end-perfect" (Kessendorf — Hollow Night, after Compline), line 14 of 18.

s5-end-perfect.015.text: It is the end. It is not perfect. There is no such thing as a perfect end. There is only the next patient.
s5-end-perfect.015.speaker: Dr. Kreuzer
s5-end-perfect.015.context: The Perfect End: failure scene when the finale (op5-9) is lost, before the retry prompt "s5-end-perfect" (Kessendorf — Hollow Night, after Compline), line 15 of 18.

s5-end-perfect.016.text: He picks up the lancet. His hands are the only moving thing in the city.
s5-end-perfect.016.speaker: Narrator
s5-end-perfect.016.context: The Perfect End: failure scene when the finale (op5-9) is lost, before the retry prompt "s5-end-perfect" (Kessendorf — Hollow Night, after Compline), line 16 of 18.

s5-end-perfect.017.speaker: Dr. Kreuzer
s5-end-perfect.017.context: The Perfect End: failure scene when the finale (op5-9) is lost, before the retry prompt "s5-end-perfect" (Kessendorf — Hollow Night, after Compline), line 17 of 18.

s5-end-perfect.018.text: THE PERFECT END — the Office is complete. Try the operation again.
s5-end-perfect.018.speaker: Narrator
s5-end-perfect.018.context: The Perfect End: failure scene when the finale (op5-9) is lost, before the retry prompt "s5-end-perfect" (Kessendorf — Hollow Night, after Compline), line 18 of 18.

recap.ch2.001.text: In the winter of the ninth year of the Long Muster, Dr. Kreuzer took up the knife at the Hospice of Saint Ildra in Kessendorf.
recap.ch2.001.context: Chapter-select recap before ch2 ("previously"), sentence 1 of 3. Narration.

recap.ch2.002.text: A page-boy came in with a mark under his skin that sang, and Kreuzer drew the forbidden star to cut the Malison of Matins out of him.
recap.ch2.002.context: Chapter-select recap before ch2 ("previously"), sentence 2 of 3. Narration.

recap.ch2.003.text: Inquisitor Stroh of the Ash Tribunal saw a candle stop flickering, and has not stopped watching since.
recap.ch2.003.context: Chapter-select recap before ch2 ("previously"), sentence 3 of 3. Narration.

recap.ch3.001.text: The Watch marched to the barrow-fields with Kreuzer as its surgeon, and brought home a cantor whose chest was a lattice of sigils.
recap.ch3.001.context: Chapter-select recap before ch3 ("previously"), sentence 1 of 3. Narration.

recap.ch3.002.text: At the muster, the Malison of Lauds sang through its host until Kreuzer silenced it — some say by the Litany, in front of witnesses.
recap.ch3.002.context: Chapter-select recap before ch3 ("previously"), sentence 2 of 3. Narration.

recap.ch3.003.text: Stroh has promised they will speak after Prime. It is after Prime.
recap.ch3.003.context: Chapter-select recap before ch3 ("previously"), sentence 3 of 3. Narration.

recap.ch4.001.text: In the Kilnrows, Kreuzer examined a hornchild for the Tribunal and wrote a certificate that will follow him.
recap.ch4.001.context: Chapter-select recap before ch4 ("previously"), sentence 1 of 3. Narration.

recap.ch4.002.text: The Guild put his licence to a vote, and Master Haller stood up for him with hands the hexfire of Terce had burned.
recap.ch4.002.context: Chapter-select recap before ch4 ("previously"), sentence 2 of 3. Narration.

recap.ch4.003.text: Now Kessendorf hires out its war, and the Watch marches east to the Vennmark with its surgeon in the second wagon.
recap.ch4.003.context: Chapter-select recap before ch4 ("previously"), sentence 3 of 3. Narration.

recap.ch5.001.text: In the rain of the Vennmark, Kreuzer kept Mauer’s men alive through Sext and None, in tents that never stopped leaking.
recap.ch5.001.context: Chapter-select recap before ch5 ("previously"), sentence 1 of 3. Narration.

recap.ch5.002.text: The council roll showed Stroh’s charter had lapsed at the new year; what the Tribunal did since, it did on nothing.
recap.ch5.002.context: Chapter-select recap before ch5 ("previously"), sentence 2 of 3. Narration.

recap.ch5.003.text: They came home to Kessendorf three days before Hollow Night, and a warrant with the Doctor’s name on it.
recap.ch5.003.context: Chapter-select recap before ch5 ("previously"), sentence 3 of 3. Narration.

bark.traction.text: Pull on the limb first — traction, or the ends grind.
bark.traction.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.overshoot.text: Stop at the end of the line — you’ve nicked him.
bark.overshoot.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.incision-layer.text: Through the skin. Now the layer beneath — trace it again.
bark.incision-layer.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.stitch-gap.text: There’s a gap in the suture — it’s still bleeding. Close it up.
bark.stitch-gap.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.stitch-first.text: It keeps filling — stitch the wound beneath it first, then drain.
bark.stitch-first.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.pus-wound.text: The pus is getting into that cut — drain it before it festers!
bark.pus-wound.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.flooded.text: Too much blood — draw it off with the leech-pipe before you stitch!
bark.flooded.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.compound.text: The bone’s through the skin — set it before you stitch over it.
bark.compound.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.salve-big.text: Salve won’t hold a wound that size. Stitch it first.
bark.salve-big.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.hex-whisper.text: It’s whispering to him through the tongs — into the lead dish, quickly!
bark.hex-whisper.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.hexstone.text: The hexstone is corrupting the flesh around it — get it out!
bark.hexstone.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.barbs.text: Barbed! Nick the flesh at the entry with the lancet before you pull.
bark.barbs.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.axis.text: Pull along the line it went in — you’re tearing the channel!
bark.axis.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.bolt-snap.text: It snapped — the head’s still in there! Ease them out: pull, pause, then draw.
bark.bolt-snap.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.glass-slow.text: Slowly with glass — it slices as it goes.
bark.glass-slow.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.lead-dish.text: Not the tray — hexstone goes in the lead dish!
bark.lead-dish.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.drop-off.text: Right off the body, Doctor — into the tray, or it sinks back in.
bark.drop-off.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.wadding.text: Scraps of wadding went in with the shot — pull those out too, or it’ll fester.
bark.wadding.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.hex-tell.text: Green flicker — it’s rekindling! Brand out the ember!
bark.hex-tell.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.burn-salve.text: The dead flesh is off. Now salve the raw burn.
bark.burn-salve.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.burn-core.text: The dead core’s out. Pluck the rest of the eschar, then salve.
bark.burn-core.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.burn-char.text: That centre is dead flesh — cut the char out with the lancet first!
bark.burn-char.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.acid-first.text: The acid’s still live! Draw it off with the leech-pipe before you salve.
bark.acid-first.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.burn-eschar.text: Pluck away the charred eschar with the tongs first!
bark.burn-eschar.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.hex-ember.text: Its ember still glows — brand it out or the hexfire will rekindle!
bark.hex-ember.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.bubo-cut.text: Draw a short cut across the crown — a prick won’t open it.
bark.bubo-cut.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.bubo-overcut.text: Too long a cut — it’s spilling everywhere. Short and across the crown!
bark.bubo-overcut.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.pus.text: Draw off the pus before you salve it.
bark.pus.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.venom-mote.text: The venom’s running for his heart along the vein — sear or draw off the drops, or tie the vein!
bark.venom-mote.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.grub-burrow.text: One’s burrowed in! Find it with the lens.
bark.grub-burrow.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.grub-split.text: Don’t let go half-way — hold the brand until it stops moving!
bark.grub-split.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.sigil-regress.text: Don’t stop half-way — the curse heals what you leave!
bark.sigil-regress.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.lauds.the_choir_is_silenced.text: The choir is silenced — its heart is bare! Brand it, now!
bark.lauds.the_choir_is_silenced.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.lauds-response.text: It heals from the other body! Strike one, then the other — quickly!
bark.lauds-response.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.lauds-hymn.text: It’s singing — every verse tears him open! Stitch the cuts as they come!
bark.lauds-hymn.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.lauds-flare.text: The dawn — I can’t see a thing through the Lens! Wait for the glare to pass!
bark.lauds-flare.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.lauds-under.text: It’s gone under the skin! The Scrying Lens — hunt its ripples!
bark.lauds-under.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.lauds-surface.text: There! It’s surfacing — brand it before it dives!
bark.lauds-surface.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.lauds-shielded.text: The Voices shield it. Silence them first — trace each one’s sigil with the brand.
bark.lauds-shielded.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.lauds.it_has_split_in.text: It has split in two — and the halves sing to each other! Strike one, then the other, before it answers!
bark.lauds.it_has_split_in.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.lauds.dawn_is_breaking_and.text: Dawn is breaking — and it has dived! Find it with the Lens between the flares!
bark.lauds.dawn_is_breaking_and.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.lauds.it_shattered_hexstone_everywh.text: It shattered — hexstone, everywhere! Get every shard out before it spoils him!
bark.lauds.it_shattered_hexstone_everywh.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.lauds.the_thread_has_rewoven.text: The thread has rewoven — they’re linked again!
bark.lauds.the_thread_has_rewoven.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.lauds-dim.text: The thread between them dims — cut across it with the lancet, now!
bark.lauds-dim.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.lauds-bright.text: Not while it blazes — wait for the thread to dim.
bark.lauds-bright.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.lauds.severed_strike_freely_while.text: Severed! Strike freely while they’re apart!
bark.lauds.severed_strike_freely_while.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.lauds-voice-trace.text: Holding it there won’t quiet it — trace the Voice’s sigil with the brand, line by line.
bark.lauds-voice-trace.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.eggsac-lanced.text: Spiderlings! Brand them before they scatter!
bark.eggsac-lanced.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.malison-open.text: Its shroud has parted — sear it with the brand, now!
bark.malison-open.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.malison-rend.text: It’s tearing the flesh as it moves! Stitch those wounds!
bark.malison-rend.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.matins-shards.text: It’s shedding shards — they’re crawling for the wounds! Tongs — cast them out!
bark.matins-shards.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.matins-gaze.text: The eye has fixed on your hand — move off its line!
bark.matins-gaze.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.matins-offbeat.text: Only on the third beat, Doctor — when the eye is wide!
bark.matins-offbeat.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.malison.its_quickening_doctor_the.text: It’s quickening! Doctor — the Litany. Draw the star with the right hand and still the hour.
bark.malison.its_quickening_doctor_the.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.malison.the_shroud_has_burned.text: The shroud has burned away — an eye! Brand it on the third beat, and only then!
bark.malison.the_shroud_has_burned.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.malison.its_splitting_apart_seize.text: It’s splitting apart! Seize every shard with the tongs and cast it out — before they rejoin!
bark.malison.its_splitting_apart_seize.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.operation.now_doctor_the_litany.text: Now, Doctor — the Litany. Draw the five-pointed star with the right hand.
bark.operation.now_doctor_the_litany.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.operation.i_have_it_doctor.text: I have it, Doctor — keep working.
bark.operation.i_have_it_doctor.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.overheat.text: The brand’s overheated. Give it a moment between searings.
bark.overheat.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.brand-flesh.text: Careful! The brand is searing healthy flesh!
bark.brand-flesh.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.reopened.text: You’ve cut through your own stitches! Close it again.
bark.reopened.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.inject-wound.text: Not into the wound, Doctor — clean flesh, away from the cuts.
bark.inject-wound.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.inject-waste.text: He didn’t need that, Doctor. Save the tincture.
bark.inject-waste.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.overdose.text: Too much tincture — your hands are shaking!
bark.overdose.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.operation.vitals_are_failing_use.text: Vitals are failing! Use the tincture, Doctor!
bark.operation.vitals_are_failing_use.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.operation.everythings_clear_close_t.text: Everything’s clear. Close the incision with the thread.
bark.operation.everythings_clear_close_t.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.operation.hes_burning_up_something.text: He’s burning up — something was left in the wound! Keep him alive through the fever.
bark.operation.hes_burning_up_something.speaker: Sister Ilse

bark.salve-dry.text: The salve pot’s empty — give it a moment to refill.
bark.salve-dry.speaker: Sister Ilse
